snippet.title: We're All In! - Official Launch Trailer!
snippet.description:
WE'RE ALL IN! is minigame madness with none of the board-om. Challenge your friends to a huge selection of minigames while betting on who will emerge victorious! 

Is your friend infamously unlucky? Are your reflexes the fastest of the bunch? Place your bets, then see who comes out on top in free for alls, team modes, and 1v1s

BET!!!
How many chips are you willing to lay down on your buddy’s reflexes? Are they infamously shit at rock-paper-scissors? WE’RE ALL IN! will shine truth on your friendships.
